item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.20
item.description: Spotify links now use the team's own Spotify keys, so they stop failing on spotDL's busy shared key (your own keys in Settings still win). A rate-limit now says so, with an Add Spotify keys button. Adding a licence from the Health check works and says so there, and file choosers come to the front. A new Mac no longer gets asked to install Apple's developer tools.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.19
item.description: Send logs now sends the zip to Pete itself, attached, with a note of what happened - no email app needed. If it can't, the email opens and Finder comes to the front with the zip ready to drag on.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.18
item.description: Settings now fill the window, with tabs down the side (Health check, Avid, Imports, Licence & updates, About & logs) so you see one group at a time. Scroll bars are clearer, including the queue's.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.17
item.description: Lists of links download as they're read: each link's track starts downloading as soon as it's found, while the next links are still being looked up (for lists you've chosen, like a CSV, when no size question is needed).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.16
item.description: Faster lists of links: all the links are read at once instead of one after another (Spotify links in one go, others four at a time), and three tracks download at once instead of two.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.15
item.description: New: drop a CSV (or a .txt) of YouTube or Spotify links on the window, or put it in the watch folder: it becomes one playlist bin named after the file, tracks in the list's order. Audio or video follows the music/video switch in IN.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.14
item.description: Fix: Bad MxFer kept in the Dock now opens when you click it (the Dock was keeping the window's own little app, which did nothing when opened on its own). After updating, quit Bad MxFer's window once and open it again.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.13
item.description: A sound when an import finishes (Settings: switch it off), a little flourish (the wallet closes with a stitched tick), stitched progress bars, progress on the Dock icon, and a running tally in Settings: imports, tracks and roughly how much time it's saved.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.12
item.description: If the health check can't run, it now says why (and the reason goes in the logs).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.11
item.description: The MXF media box now has its own arrow into the queue, and the arrows to and from Bins disappear when bins are switched off.
